     2	name: web-designer
     3	description: >-
     4	  Designs user interfaces with clear information hierarchy, intuitive
     5	  interaction patterns, and accessibility-first layouts. Use when creating
     6	  wireframes, evaluating UX flows, auditing visual hierarchy, designing
     7	  responsive layouts, or improving usability of existing Loom interfaces.
     8	metadata:
     9	  role: Web Designer
    10	  level: ic
    11	  reports_to: product-manager
    12	  specialties:
    13	  - UI/UX design
    14	  - interaction patterns
    15	  - visual hierarchy
    16	  - accessibility
    17	  - responsive layout
    18	  display_name: Charlie Reeves
    19	  author: loom
    20	  version: '3.0'
    21	license: Proprietary
    22	compatibility: Designed for Loom
    23	---
    24	
    25	# Web Designer
    26	
    27	You design how users interact with Loom. Every screen, button, and piece of
    28	information is evaluated from the user's perspective: is it findable, is it
    29	clear, does it respect the user's time?
    30	
    31	## Primary Skill
    32	
    33	Your default lens is user experience. You evaluate interfaces by asking three
    34	questions in order:
    35	
    36	1. **Can the user find it?** (information architecture, navigation, visual hierarchy)
    37	2. **Can the user understand it?** (labels, layout, progressive disclosure)
    38	3. **Can the user complete the task?** (interaction flow, error recovery, feedback)
    39	
    40	### Design workflow
    41	
    42	1. **Clarify the goal** — what user task does this interface serve? Write it as a single sentence.
    43	2. **Map the flow** — sketch the steps from entry to completion. Identify decision points and error states.
    44	3. **Design the layout** — establish visual hierarchy. Primary action prominent, secondary actions accessible but not competing.
    45	4. **Validate accessibility** — check color contrast (WCAG AA minimum), touch targets (44px minimum), keyboard flow, screen reader order.
    46	5. **Review** — walk through the flow as three user types: first-time, returning, power user.
    47	
    48	### Example: designing a bead status filter
    49	
    50	```
    51	Goal: Let users filter the bead list by status (open, in-progress, closed).
    52	
    53	Flow:
    54	  1. User sees bead list (default: all statuses).
    55	  2. User clicks filter control -> dropdown appears with status options.
    56	  3. User selects one or more statuses -> list updates immediately.
    57	  4. Active filters shown as removable chips above the list.
    58	
    59	Layout decisions:
    60	  - Filter control placed top-left, aligned with list header (scan line).
    61	  - Chips use distinct background color with "x" dismiss button (44px target).
    62	  - Empty state: "No beads match this filter" with clear-all action.
    63	
    64	Accessibility:
    65	  - Filter dropdown: aria-haspopup="listbox", arrow key navigation.
    66	  - Chips: role="status" with aria-label "Remove filter: open".
    67	  - Live region announces "Showing 12 beads" on filter change.
    68	```
    69	
    70	## Org Position
    71	
    72	- **Reports to:** Product Manager
    73	- **Direct reports:** None
    74	
    75	## Available Skills
    76	
    77	You are not limited to design. Use other skills when the situation demands it:
    78	
    79	- **Front-end code** — implement your designs directly in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when that is faster than handing off.
    80	- **Documentation** — update UI screenshots and usage guides when designs change.
    81	- **Backend adjustments** — when a design change requires a small backend tweak (e.g., adding a display field to an API response), make it yourself.
    82	
    83	**When to do it yourself vs delegate:**
    84	- **Do it yourself:** The implementation is straightforward CSS/HTML and you can ship it faster than writing a handoff spec.
    85	- **Delegate:** The change requires complex state management, database changes, or performance-critical code.
    86	- **Call a meeting:** The design affects multiple product areas or changes established interaction patterns.
    87	
    88	## Model Selection
    89	
    90	- **Design decisions** (UX flow, information architecture, interaction patterns): strongest model — nuanced reasoning required
    91	- **CSS/layout implementation** (translating approved designs to code): mid-tier model
    92	- **Quick mockups** (rough wireframes, placeholder layouts): lightweight model

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #0A0A0A;
      --bg-secondary: #111111;
      --bg-tertiary: #1A1A1A;
      --bg-card: #141414;
      --text-primary: #FFFFFF;
      --text-secondary: #B0B0B0;
      --text-muted: #808080;
      --accent: #3B82F6;
      --accent-hover: #2563EB;
      --border: #2A2A2A;
      --border-light: #333333;
      --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-slow: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      background-color: var(--bg-primary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    /* ===== NAVIGATION ===== */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-inner {
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 2rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }

    .nav-logo {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2.5rem;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .nav-links a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--accent);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .language-selector {
      position: relative;
    }

    .language-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0.5rem;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .language-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .language-btn svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .language-btn.active svg {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .language-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 0.5rem);
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      min-width: 160px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .language-dropdown.active {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .language-dropdown a {
      display: block;
      padding: 0.625rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .language-dropdown a:hover {
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .language-dropdown a.active {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .nav-mobile-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0.5rem;
    }

    .nav-mobile-toggle span {
      display: block;
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      margin: 5px 0;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    /* ===== HERO CAROUSEL ===== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      height: 100vh;
      min-height: 700px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-slides {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .hero-slide {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition-slow);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-slide.active {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .hero-slide-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
    }

    .hero-slide-bg::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.95) 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.7) 50%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.4) 100%);
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 2rem;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .hero-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem;
      background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
      border-radius: 100px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .hero-desc {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .hero-nav {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 3rem;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 10;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .hero-nav-btn {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .hero-nav-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }

    .hero-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .hero-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .hero-dot.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      width: 32px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .hero-progress {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--accent);
      transition: width 0.1s linear;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    /* ===== SECTION UTILITIES ===== */
    .section {
      padding: 6rem 0;
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 2rem;
    }

    .section-header {
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    .section-tag {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      display: block;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ===== TEAM SECTION ===== */
    .team-section {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .team-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .team-tab {
      padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .team-tab:hover {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border-color: var(--border-light);
    }

    .team-tab.active {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--accent);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .team-carousel {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
      padding-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .team-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(33.333% - 1rem);
      min-width: 320px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .team-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .team-card-photo {
      width: 100%;
      height: 280px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    }

    .team-card-body {
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    .team-card-quote {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .team-card-name {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .team-card-title {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .team-card-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .team-card-cta:hover {
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .team-carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .team-carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .team-carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--border-light);
    }

    .team-carousel-btn:disabled {
      opacity: 0.3;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    /* ===== WORK SHOWCASE ===== */
    .work-section {
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .work-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .work-scroll-container {
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      margin: 0 -2rem;
      padding: 0 2rem;
    }

    .work-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .work-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .work-card {
      flex: 0 0 420px;
      min-width: 320px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .work-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .work-card-image {
      width: 100%;
      height: 280px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    }

    .work-card-body {
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    .work-card-client {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .work-card-title {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .work-card-quote {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .work-card-quote-author {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      font-style: normal;
    }

    .work-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .work-nav-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .work-nav-btn:hover {
      background: var(--border-light);
    }

    /* ===== CTA BANNER ===== */
    .cta-banner {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 5rem 0;
    }

    .cta-banner-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .cta-banner-body {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto 2rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .cta-banner-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .cta-banner-btn:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ===== HOW WE WORK ===== */
    .how-we-work {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .how-we-work-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 4rem;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .how-we-work-content {
      max-width: 540px;
    }

    .how-we-work-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .how-we-work-body {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .how-we-work-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .how-we-work-cta:hover {
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .how-we-work-visual {
      position: relative;
      height: 480px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .how-we-work-visual img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    /* ===== INSIGHTS ===== */
    .insights-section {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .insights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .insight-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .insight-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .insight-card-image {
      width: 100%;
      height: 180px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    }

    .insight-card-body {
      padding: 1.25rem;
    }

    .insight-card-type {
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .insight-card-title {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .insight-card-cta {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .insight-card:hover .insight-card-cta {
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* ===== PRINCIPLES ===== */
    .principles-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    .principle-card {
      padding: 2.5rem;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .principle-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
    }

    .principle-number {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      display: block;
    }

    .principle-title {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .principle-desc {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 5rem 0 2rem;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      margin-bottom: 4rem;
    }

    .footer-brand {
      max-width: 360px;
    }

    .footer-logo {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .footer-desc {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .footer-cta-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .footer-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem;
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .footer-cta:hover {
      background: var(--border-light);
      border-color: var(--border-light);
    }

    .footer-cta.primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: white;
    }

    .footer-cta.primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      border-color: var(--accent-hover);
    }

    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .footer-links {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .footer-links li {
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-top: 2rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .footer-copyright {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-legal a:hover {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* ===== COOKIE CONSENT ===== */
    .cookie-banner {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 9999;
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
      transform: translateY(100%);
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .cookie-banner.active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .cookie-inner {
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .cookie-text {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .cookie-text a {
      color: var(--accent);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .cookie-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .cookie-btn {
      padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border: none;
    }

    .cookie-btn.accept {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
    }

    .cookie-btn.accept:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
    }

    .cookie-btn.settings {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .cookie-btn.settings:hover {
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .cookie-btn.decline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .cookie-btn.decline:hover {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* ===== COOKIE SETTINGS MODAL ===== */
    .cookie-modal {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 10000;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .cookie-modal.active {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .cookie-modal-content {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 2rem;
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 90%;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .cookie-modal.active .cookie-modal-content {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .cookie-modal-title {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .cookie-modal-desc {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .cookie-option {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 1rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .cookie-option-label {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .cookie-option-desc {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: 0.25rem;
    }

    .toggle-switch {
      position: relative;
      width: 44px;
      height: 24px;
      background: var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .toggle-switch.active {
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    .toggle-switch::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 2px;
      left: 2px;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .toggle-switch.active::after {
      left: 22px;
    }

    .cookie-modal-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE MENU ===== */
    .mobile-menu {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 999;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-menu.active {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .mobile-menu a {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .mobile-menu-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 1.5rem;
      right: 1.5rem;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-size: 2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .nav-links {
        display: none;
      }

      .nav-mobile-toggle {
        display: block;
      }

      .team-card {
        flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 0.75rem);
      }

      .insights-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .how-we-work-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 2rem;
      }

      .how-we-work-visual {
        height: 320px;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .section {
        padding: 4rem 0;
      }

      .hero {
        min-height: 600px;
      }

      .hero-nav {
        bottom: 2rem;
      }

      .team-card {
        flex: 0 0 100%;
        min-width: 280px;
      }

      .work-card {
        flex: 0 0 320px;
      }

      .insights-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .principles-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 2rem;
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .cookie-inner {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .nav-inner {
        padding: 0 1rem;
      }

      .section-inner {
        padding: 0 1rem;
      }

      .work-scroll-container {
        margin: 0 -1rem;
        padding: 0 1rem;

  <script>
    // ===== TEAM DATA =====
    const teamData = {
      'north-america': [
        {
          name: 'Denice Alvarez',
          title: 'Office Manager',
          office: 'New York',
          quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.',
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1573496359142-b8d87734a5a2?w=400&q=80'
        },
        {
          name: 'Marco Bellini',
          title: 'Design Director',
          office: 'San Francisco',
          quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.',
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?w=400&q=80'
        }
      ],
      'asia': [
        {
          name: 'Priya Mehta',
          title: 'Studio Head',
          office: 'Bangalore',
          quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.',
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580489944761-15a19d654956?w=400&q=80'
        },
        {
          name: 'Thierry Lam',
          title: 'Design Lead',
          office: 'Singapore',
          quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.',
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500648767791-00dcc994a43e?w=400&q=80'
        }
      ],
      'europe': [
        {
          name: 'Gavin Hartley',
          title: 'Managing Director',
          office: 'London',
          quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results.",
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=400&q=80'
        },
        {
          name: 'Francesca Terzi',
          title: 'Design Director',
          office: 'Munich',
          quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.',
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1438761681033-6461ffad8d80?w=400&q=80'
        }
      ],
      'oceania': [
        {
          name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho',
          title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation',
          office: 'Melbourne',
          quote: "I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven't thought of before.",
          photo: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544005313-94ddf0286df2?w=400&q=80'
        }
      ]
    };

    // ===== HERO CAROUSEL =====
    const heroSlides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
    const heroDotsContainer = document.getElementById('heroDots');
    const heroProgress = document.getElementById('heroProgress');
    let currentHeroSlide = 0;
    let heroInterval;
    const heroAutoplayDuration = 6000;
    let heroProgressStart;
    let heroProgressFrame;

    function createHeroDots() {
      heroSlides.forEach((_, i) => {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'hero-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => goToHeroSlide(i));
        heroDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      });
    }

    function updateHeroProgress() {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - heroProgressStart;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / heroAutoplayDuration, 1);
      heroProgress.style.width = `${progress * 100}%`;
      if (progress < 1) {
        heroProgressFrame = requestAnimationFrame(updateHeroProgress);
      }
    }

    function goToHeroSlide(index) {
      heroSlides[currentHeroSlide].classList.remove('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot')[currentHeroSlide].classList.remove('active');
      currentHeroSlide = index;
      if (currentHeroSlide >= heroSlides.length) currentHeroSlide = 0;
      if (currentHeroSlide < 0) currentHeroSlide = heroSlides.length - 1;
      heroSlides[currentHeroSlide].classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot')[currentHeroSlide].classList.add('active');
      resetHeroAutoplay();
    }

    function nextHeroSlide() {
      goToHeroSlide(currentHeroSlide + 1);
    }

    function prevHeroSlide() {
      goToHeroSlide(currentHeroSlide - 1);
    }

    function resetHeroAutoplay() {
      clearInterval(heroInterval);
      cancelAnimationFrame(heroProgressFrame);
      heroProgress.style.width = '0%';
      heroProgressStart = Date.now();
      heroProgressFrame = requestAnimationFrame(updateHeroProgress);
      heroInterval = setInterval(nextHeroSlide, heroAutoplayDuration);
    }

    document.getElementById('heroPrev').addEventListener('click', prevHeroSlide);
    document.getElementById('heroNext').addEventListener('click', nextHeroSlide);

    // ===== TEAM CAROUSEL =====
    const teamTrack = document.getElementById('teamTrack');
    const teamTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.team-tab');
    let currentRegion = 'north-america';
    let teamScrollPos = 0;

    function renderTeamCards(region) {
      const members = teamData[region];
      teamTrack.innerHTML = members.map(member => `
        <div class="team-card">
          <img class="team-card-photo" src="${member.photo}" alt="${member.name}" loading="lazy">
          <div class="team-card-body">
            <p class="team-card-quote">"${member.quote}"</p>
            <h4 class="team-card-name">${member.name}</h4>
            <p class="team-card-title">${member.title}</p>
            <a href="#contact" class="team-card-cta">
              Contact Leap Studio ${member.office}
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"></polyline>
              </svg>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
      teamScrollPos = 0;
      teamTrack.style.transform = `translateX(0)`;
      updateTeamNavButtons();
    }

    function updateTeamNavButtons() {
      const cardWidth = teamTrack.querySelector('.team-card')?.offsetWidth + 24 || 0;
      const maxScroll = Math.max(0, teamTrack.scrollWidth - teamTrack.parentElement.offsetWidth);
      document.getElementById('teamPrev').disabled = teamScrollPos <= 0;
      document.getElementById('teamNext').disabled = teamScrollPos >= maxScroll;
    }

    function scrollTeam(direction) {
      const containerWidth = teamTrack.parentElement.offsetWidth;
      const cardWidth = teamTrack.querySelector('.team-card')?.offsetWidth + 24 || containerWidth;
      const maxScroll = Math.max(0, teamTrack.scrollWidth - containerWidth);
      teamScrollPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxScroll, teamScrollPos + direction * cardWidth));
      teamTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamScrollPos}px)`;
      updateTeamNavButtons();
    }

    teamTabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        teamTabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
        tab.classList.add('active');
        currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
        renderTeamCards(currentRegion);
      });
    });

    document.getElementById('teamPrev').addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
    document.getElementById('teamNext').addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

    // ===== WORK CAROUSEL =====
    const workScroll = document.getElementById('workScroll');

    function scrollWork(direction) {
      const cardWidth = workScroll.querySelector('.work-card')?.offsetWidth + 24 || 444;
      workScroll.scrollBy({ left: direction * cardWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    document.getElementById('workPrev').addEventListener('click', () => scrollWork(-1));
    document.getElementById('workNext').addEventListener('click', () => scrollWork(1));

    // ===== LANGUAGE SELECTOR =====
    const languageBtn = document.getElementById('languageBtn');
    const languageDropdown = document.getElementById('languageDropdown');

    languageBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      languageBtn.classList.toggle('active');
      languageBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', languageBtn.classList.contains('active'));
      languageDropdown.classList.toggle('active');
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', () => {
      languageBtn.classList.remove('active');
      languageBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      languageDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    });

    // ===== MOBILE MENU =====
    const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    const mobileMenuClose = document.getElementById('mobileMenuClose');

    mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mobileMenu.classList.add('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    });

    mobileMenuClose.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });

    mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    // ===== COOKIE CONSENT =====
    const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
    const cookieModal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
    const cookieAccept = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
    const cookieDecline = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
    const cookieSettings = document.getElementById('cookieSettings');
    const cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');
    const cookieModalCancel = document.getElementById('cookieModalCancel');
    const cookieModalSave = document.getElementById('cookieModalSave');
    const analyticsToggle = document.getElementById('analyticsToggle');
    const marketingToggle = document.getElementById('marketingToggle');

    function showCookieBanner() {
      if (!localStorage.getItem('cookieConsent')) {
        setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('active'), 1000);
      }
    }

    function hideCookieBanner() {
      cookieBanner.classList.remove('active');
    }

    function openCookieModal() {
      cookieModal.classList.add('active');
      hideCookieBanner();
    }

    function closeCookieModal() {
      cookieModal.classList.remove('active');
    }

    cookieAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
      localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent', 'all');
      hideCookieBanner();
    });

    cookieDecline.addEventListener('click', () => {
      localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent', 'essential');
      hideCookieBanner();
    });

    cookieSettings.addEventListener('click', openCookieModal);
    cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      openCookieModal();
    });
    cookieModalCancel.addEventListener('click', closeCookieModal);

    cookieModalSave.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const analytics = analyticsToggle.classList.contains('active');
      const marketing = marketingToggle.classList.contains('active');
      const consent = { essential: true, analytics, marketing };
      localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent', JSON.stringify(consent));
      closeCookieModal();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-switch:not([data-locked="true"])').forEach(toggle => {
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggle.classList.toggle('active');
      });
    });

    cookieModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === cookieModal) closeCookieModal();
    });

    // ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
    const fadeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');

    const fadeObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });

    fadeElements.forEach(el => fadeObserver.observe(el));

    // ===== NAVBAR SCROLL EFFECT =====
    const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
    let lastScroll = 0;

    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
      if (currentScroll > 100) {
        navbar.style.background = 'rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.95)';
      } else {
        navbar.style.background = 'rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.85)';
      }
      lastScroll = currentScroll;
    });

    // ===== INIT =====
    createHeroDots();
    resetHeroAutoplay();
    renderTeamCards('north-america');
    showCookieBanner();

    // Touch swipe for hero
    let touchStartX = 0;
    const heroSection = document.getElementById('hero');
    heroSection.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; });
    heroSection.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      const touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
      if (touchStartX - touchEndX > 50) nextHeroSlide();
      if (touchEndX - touchStartX > 50) prevHeroSlide();
    });

    // Touch swipe for team carousel
    let teamTouchStartX = 0;
    teamTrack.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { teamTouchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; });
    teamTrack.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      const touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
      if (teamTouchStartX - touchEndX > 50) scrollTeam(1);
      if (touchEndX - teamTouchStartX > 50) scrollTeam(-1);
    });

    // Keyboard nav for hero
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') nextHeroSlide();
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') prevHeroSlide();
    });

    // Handle resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      updateTeamNavButtons();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

### Structure (Single Page)
- **Hero Carousel** — 5 auto-rotating slides with progress bar, dot navigation, prev/next buttons, keyboard arrows, and touch swipe support
- **Team Section** — Region toggle tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) filtering a horizontal carousel of team member cards with photos, quotes, titles, and office CTAs
- **Work Showcase** — Horizontally scrollable project cards with client names, titles, and testimonial quotes (8 projects including Unilever, IKEA, Volvo, Chase, Tiffany & Co., Carrefour)
- **CTA Banner** — "Let's work together" with contact CTA
- **How We Work** — Two-column layout with text and visual
- **Latest Insights** — 8-card grid (podcasts, articles, insight reports)
- **Our Principles** — 4-card grid with numbered principles
- **Footer** — Brand info, CTAs, link columns, legal links

### Interactions Implemented
| Interaction | Details |
|---|---|
| **Hero Carousel** | 6s autoplay with progress bar, manual nav, keyboard & touch support |
| **Team Region Toggle** | 4 tabs filter team members; carousel with prev/next buttons & touch swipe |
| **Work Carousel** | Horizontal scroll with snap points; prev/next buttons |
| **Language Selector** | Dropdown toggle (Global EN / France FR / China CN) |
| **Cookie Consent** | Banner with Accept All / Decline All / Manage Settings; modal with toggles for Analytics & Marketing |
| **Mobile Menu** | Hamburger toggle with full-screen overlay |
| **Scroll Animations** | Fade-in animations via IntersectionObserver |

### Design System
- **Dark mode only**: `#0A0A0A` background with white typography
- **Accent**: Electric blue `#3B82F6`
- **Typography**: Inter (Google Fonts), weights 300–900
- **Responsive**: Breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, 480px with mobile menu, stacked grids, and adapted carousels
- **Accessibility**: ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus states, 44px+ touch targets
